title: Module 3 Quiz: Neural Networks & Deep Learning

questions.text: What is the role of the hidden layers in a neural network?
options: They receive raw input data from the outside world.
They produce the final prediction or action.
They examine every piece of data from different angles to spot subtle patterns.
They adjust the learning rate during training.
questions.explanation: Hidden layers process inputs to detect patterns.

questions.text: What advantage do deep learning neural networks have over traditional machine learning models?
options: They require less data to train effectively.
They automatically extract complex patterns from raw, unstructured data without manual feature design.
They eliminate the need for any computing power.
They only work with structured spreadsheet data.
questions.explanation: Deep learning extracts features automatically from raw data.

questions.text: True or false: Generative AI models can produce fluent-sounding answers that contain made-up information because they predict word probabilities rather than retrieve verified facts.
True or false: The input layer directly adjusts the weights of connections based on prediction errors.
questions.explanation: Input layer only receives data; weight adjustment occurs during training in hidden/output layers.
